label: Narrative
description: Organized as a story, chronology, journey, investigation, or unfolding sequence rather than primarily as a reference or theoretical argument.

label: Character-driven
description: Centers people, relationships, biographies, communities, or a small cast whose actions carry the book.

label: Reported
description: Built from journalism, interviews, fieldwork, eyewitness accounts, or scene-based reportage.

label: Memoiristic
description: Uses first-person experience, family history, personal memory, or autobiographical structure.

label: Biographical
description: Primarily tells the life of one person or a small group of people.

label: Essayistic
description: Composed as essays, criticism, meditations, reflections, or literary-cultural argument.

label: Literary prose
description: Explicitly described by source text as lyrical, elegant, beautifully written, stylish, or otherwise notable for prose craft.

label: Argument-driven
description: Primarily advances a thesis, interpretation, critique, or conceptual argument.

label: Synthesis
description: Offers a broad overview, big-picture account, survey, or synthesis across a large topic or period.

label: Academic
description: Written mainly for scholarly readers or emerging from academic monograph conventions.

label: Scholarly
description: Research-heavy, source-dense, historiographical, theoretical, or disciplinary in method.

label: Accessible
description: Likely approachable for general readers, with readable prose, clear storytelling, or broad-audience framing.

label: Dense
description: Likely difficult, specialized, theoretical, reference-like, multi-volume, or jargon-heavy.

label: Popular
description: Trade-oriented, general-audience, bestseller-adjacent, or framed for broad public readership.

label: Experimental
description: Formally unusual, hybrid, fragmented, graphic, poetic, or genre-bending.

label: Reference
description: Primarily handbook, guide, encyclopedia, catalog, atlas, bibliography, index, or reference work.
